items.q: So, in other words, the Mutt Corey Ory and Dorensbourg Dorensbourg, front line... Mutt stayed with us, up there with the band

ctx.x: I was with them for 42 years.
42, that's right. So, in other words, the Mutt Corey Ory and Dorensbourg Dorensbourg, front line, how long did that stay together?
Mutt stayed with us, up there with the band, clean up till -- let me see, get that thing right. We was playing for Orson Welles Welles, remember?
